snippet.title: NEW MODERATION TOOLS! More safety to your Game!
snippet.description:
We're excited to announce our latest update to Gartic Phone: Moderation Tool!

By using the moderation tab, you'll be able to keep a close eye to make sure that any disrespectful actions won't be displayed in the match or album!

this tool helps you play in a healthier and safer environment. 

Contact us on our Discord server if you have any questions or feedback.

OUR DISCORD: https://discord.com/invite/gartic
